messages:
Eli (AE): Quick: Prospect 'Clearline' wants a 10-business-day POC. Scope = 3 micro-flows: routing, note-summarization, reply-tone. Need baseline prompt set, 100 gold samples/flow, eval script, and a headline cost. Can SEs deliver by tomorrow AM? @Mar @Noor
Mar (SE): Yes. Hosted-first; be ready to show Dedicated for KMS/SSO. I'll produce a minimal prompt inventory and annotate expected outputs.
Tess (Solutions Eng): Eval plan: 100 examples/flow to start. I can wire the harness. Example run: `./eval --suite clearline_quick --n 100 --model redwood-hosted-v1`
Noor (PM): Suggested success gates: routing accuracy >= 0.75, summary ROUGE-L >= 0.58, tone-accept >= 80% on a 150-sample blind check, p95 latency <600ms. Mid-POC checkpoint day 5.
Mar (SE): Prompt sketches (compact):
1) routing_v1: "Pick label from [billing, onboarding, bug, other] - return only label."
2) summary_v1: "3-bullet summary; list action items first."
3) tone_v1: "Rewrite reply: professional, empathetic, <140 chars."
4) safety_v1: "If disallowed, output 'BLOCK' + reason; else 'OK'."
Mar (SE): I'll attach 100 golds per flow and a README with eval commands.
sales-ops-bot: provisional_cost_note: use qps 1.6 avg, peak 7, avg 260 tokens for headline estimate. Dedicated uplift ~+35% (placeholder).
Tess (Solutions Eng): Security Qs noted (KMS, retention, audit logs). I'll draft answers; escalate if control-plane isolation requested.
Noor (PM): Action items: Mar -> prompts + golds (tomorrow AM). Tess -> eval harness + sample report. Eli -> gather customer examples and confirm kickoff. Sales ops -> headline cost.
Eli (AE): Thanks team. Keep prompt set minimal and instrument token counts + latency per example. I'll present to the customer on Friday if artifacts land tomorrow.
Mar (SE): Will upload and paste link here when ready.
Tess (Solutions Eng): Adding small confidence field to responses for triage.
Noor (PM): Closing the sync; will post runbook checklist once artifacts are uploaded.
